description: Implementation of an HTTP server handling connections, requests, WebSocket communication, and connection management within the Chromium networking codebase.

classes.name: HttpServer
classes.description: Implements an HTTP server managing connections, request parsing, response handling, WebSocket support, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: HttpServer::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for handling server events such as new connections, requests, WebSocket requests, and connection closures.

classes.name: HttpConnection
classes.description: Represents a client connection, managing socket I/O buffers, WebSocket state, and connection-specific data.

methods.name: HttpServer::HttpServer
methods.description: Constructor initializing server socket and delegate, starting accept loop asynchronously.

methods.name: HttpServer::~HttpServer
methods.description: Destructor, default cleanup.

methods.name: HttpServer::AcceptWebSocket
methods.description: Accepts a WebSocket upgrade request on a specific connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::SendOverWebSocket
methods.description: Sends data over an established WebSocket connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::SendRaw
methods.description: Sends raw data over a connection, appending to write buffer and initiating write loop.

methods.name: HttpServer::SendResponse
methods.description: Sends an HTTP response with serialized response info.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send
methods.description: Constructs and sends an HTTP response with status, data, and content type.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send200
methods.description: Sends a 200 OK response with data.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send404
methods.description: Sends a 404 Not Found response.

methods.name: HttpServer::Send500
methods.description: Sends a 500 Internal Server Error response with message.

methods.name: HttpServer::Close
methods.description: Closes a connection, erasing from map and scheduling deletion.

methods.name: HttpServer::GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves server socket's local address.

methods.name: HttpServer::GetLocalInterfaceAddress
methods.description: Retrieves interface address if listening on INADDR_ANY (platform-specific).

methods.name: HttpServer::SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets receive buffer size for a connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets send buffer size for a connection.

methods.name: HttpServer::DoAcceptLoop
methods.description: Initiates accepting incoming connections asynchronously.

methods.name: HttpServer::OnAcceptCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of an accept operation, continuing accept loop.

methods.name: HttpServer::HandleAcceptResult
methods.description: Processes result of accept, creating connection or handling error.

methods.name: HttpServer::DoReadLoop
methods.description: Performs read operations on a connection, handling buffer resizing.

methods.name: HttpServer::OnReadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a read, continuing read loop.

methods.name: HttpServer::HandleReadResult
methods.description: Processes read result, parsing headers or WebSocket frames, handling errors.

methods.name: HttpServer::DoWriteLoop
methods.description: Performs write operations on a connection, handling partial writes.

methods.name: HttpServer::OnWriteCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of a write, continuing write loop.

methods.name: HttpServer::HandleWriteResult
methods.description: Processes write result, handling errors.

methods.name: HttpServer::ParseHeaders
methods.description: Parses HTTP headers from raw data using a simple state machine.

methods.name: HttpServer::FindConnection
methods.description: Finds a connection object by connection ID.

methods.name: HttpServer::HasClosedConnection
methods.description: Checks if a connection has been closed during callback processing.
